EmailTemplate.subject: Anticipate payment delays from China due to bank holiday
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
With banks in China closing from October 1 to 7 for the Golden Week national holiday, incoming payments to Flywire and your institution may be delayed until after the holiday.
Please reach out if you have any questions.
